title: Pricing tier comparison modal and first-launch guide assets for model catalog v2 release
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Produce a set of annotated screenshots and export-ready assets for the v2 model catalog release notes and first-run onboarding. Focus areas: pricing tier comparison modal (new compact layout), first-launch walkthrough that surfaces new models and migration guidance for deprecated models, and variants for dark mode and localized strings.
goals: Create high-fidelity screenshots for the release notes highlighting new models and deprecation state
Design a pricing tier comparison modal that fits both release notes and the onboarding flow
Provide localized (EN/FR/DE) and dark-mode variants of each screenshot
Deliver export-ready assets with clear annotations and specs for engineering and docs
export_specs: SVG exports for icons and overlays
Individual layer exports for text overlays and CTA buttons
Provide 1x and 2x for mobile screenshots (375 and 750 widths)
ux_notes: Pricing modal must show per-token and per-hour estimated unit costs for each tier, a compact comparison row for model variants, and a clearly marked migration CTA when a model is deprecated. Tooltips must be preserved in screenshots via visible '?' icons and short copy. Do not include real customer data in assets.
localization_variants: FR - translated strings provided by localization team (see Confluence link)
DE - translated strings provided by localization team
accessibility_notes: Use 4.5:1 contrast ratio for CTA buttons in light and dark modes
Include alt-text drafts for each screenshot (see acceptance criteria)
acceptance_criteria: All screenshots exported in required sizes and formats and uploaded to Drive
Figma file finalized with component tokens and agreed spacing/grid
QA review completed (visual pixel check) and signoff from PM and Eng
Release notes contain at least three annotated images: new-model card, pricing modal, deprecation banner
Localization variants verified against localization copy spreadsheet
comments: 2026-03-05 Ava Martinez: Kickoff - briefed on scope with PM. Agreed to prioritize pricing modal and deprecation banner for the release notes hero slot.
2026-03-06 Liam O'Connor: Initial wireframes uploaded to Figma. Requested compact comparison row for mobile.
2026-03-08 PM feedback (Sara Li): Emphasize migration CTA copy 'Migrate your workloads' and include expected ETA for migration in hover state.
2026-03-09 Engineering (Noah Patel): Need asset layers separated: token values, CTA, and model badges to programmatically overlay in docs site.
2026-03-11 Design review: Chose blue accent for primary CTA, left-aligned pricing table for readability. Decided against showing estimated token costs for deprecations to avoid confusion.
2026-03-12 QA visual: Minor pixel shift on modal header in dark mode; flagged and fixed in Figma.
2026-03-12 PM signoff (Sara Li): Approved final assets for staging release notes.
qa_checklist: Verify localization strings fit UI without truncation
Confirm dark-mode colors meet contrast requirements
Validate export filenames match naming convention
Ensure no PII or customer identifiers present

PM-4032: Update release notes copy with final CTA text
DES-51045: Create micro-animations for modal open/close for marketing video
notes: This ticket is focused on screenshot and asset delivery only. Any changes to the modal behavior or pricing metrics must be handled in ENG tickets and coordinated with PM. Keep all final exports in the Drive folder and notify docs lead when complete.
